name: components/status-indicator
description: A compact status dot/indicator primitive for presence and process state signaling. Supports semantic statuses, multiple sizes, and optional pulse animation for live or in-progress activity.
useCases: Online/offline presence next to avatars in messaging, CRM, and admin dashboards
In-progress/busy markers for tasks, background jobs, or deployment pipelines
Availability indicators in assignee lists, team switchers, and participant rows
Compact state chips in dense tables where full text badges are too large
